_doc: One line per shot. sparse: the first line plays over the finished colour scene, the second over the pencil sketch. objects pairs each region (scenes.json order) with its spoken line and its plain on-screen caption. Sources: examples/raw/v1.1/final.md (T1-T5) and the README blind-test table. Tested by teachback.py.
